title: Chapter 364: There Is A Secret Room Deep Underground
content:
Chapter 364: There Is A Secret Room Deep Underground

Deep underground, nearly 100 meters below the hall.

There is a secret room.

There is an altar in the secret room, which looks like a teleportation array.

There is also a spiritual spring next to it, which is similar to the spring of life that Wang Shuo got, but the spring eye is much larger.

Near the spring eye, there is a charming flower called Dream Crystal Orchid.

At this time, she has opened her spiritual wisdom and become a plant monster.

Her cultivation requires a lot of blood, so she uses her innate skills to create a false illusion treasure in the cave above to attract monsters and humans.

Then through special means, stimulate their inner desire to kill and let them kill each other.

The blood of dead monsters and humans will be absorbed by her, thereby improving her own strength.

Seeing that the battle above is extremely fierce.

She happily made a charming voice.

"Want to fight? Fight! With the most humble dream, to the sobbing and roaring in the dark night..."

(Oh! I can't help myself.)

Wang Shuo seemed to hear some mysterious voice, and the killing desire in his heart had reached an uncontrollable point.

He just wanted to kill Song Bo and the other two in the simplest way.

So, he used "Iron Chain Binding" without hesitation.

Then came a "Dragon Out of the Sea".

This was the first time he used this move to kill someone.

In the Ksitigarbha Pavilion, he re-cultivated the upgraded "Dragon Spear Art", and when he reached the third level, he understood this move.

The black dragon's internal force was poured into the spear, and a dark black dragon emerged from the Blood-Crying Spear and directly penetrated Song Bo's little brother.

He died on the spot.

It is difficult for an ordinary top-level general to kill with one move, unless he hits the opponent's head or other vital parts, but Wang Shuo's attack was clearly only on the opponent's chest.

It can only be said that the power of this attack is very terrifying.

Wang Shuo killed a high-level general in one move. If everyone was awake, they would probably feel a little scared.

But everyone was so angry that no one cared.

At the same time, Wang Shuo's Bloodthirsty Gun also had the effect of sucking blood.

Wang Shuo's blood and qi burst, which further stimulated his killing thoughts.

Gradually, the only thought left in his mind was to kill all the people and beasts here.

Next, it was Song Bo's turn.

As soon as the "Wind Step" was turned on, Wang Shuo kept moving.

Wandering around Song Bo and the other two, in this state, Wang Shuo's combat potential was infinitely stimulated.

Although Song Bo only had fighting instincts left, he was no match at all and was easily controlled by Wang Shuo.

After killing the two, Wang Shuo directly created the "Abyss Swamp" in the cave.

Although it was all stone here, this skill could forcibly change the terrain.

Suddenly, a large number of monsters were trapped in it, and many humans also fell into the swamp. Wang Shuo turned on the unparalleled mode and harvested lives wantonly.

With the help of the Swift Wind Step, Wang Shuo walked on flat ground without using the "Iron Chain Binding". He just used the two moves alternately, and even the silver-level Earth Dragon Beast could be killed with one move.

The lives in the hall were constantly decreasing.

The Dream Crystal Orchid under the ground was extremely happy.

Countless blood flowed into the ground through her control.

Soon, there were less than ten people left in the hall, and the Dark Gold Earth Dragon Beast was also beaten to death by several top generals.

If Jiang Song and others had not attacked each other, the Dark Gold Earth Dragon Beast would have been killed long ago.

At this time, Wang Shuo had already transformed into Shura, killing gods and Buddhas.

His eyes were red, emitting a dazzling red light.
